ei.title: The Future of AI and Its Impact
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② performed → perform: 조동사 could 뒤에는 동사원형
det.analysis:
❌ ① powered: 'machines powered by' 과거분사 — 정상

✅ ② could actually performed → could actually perform: 'tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform' — 조동사 could 뒤에는 동사원형 perform. performed는 오류 ← 정답

❌ ③ requiring: 'rather than requiring' 동명사 — 정상

❌ ④ to recognize: 'important to recognize' to부정사 — 정상
det.tip: 조동사(could) + 동사원형. could perform(○)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① machines learn → machines to learn: enable + 목적어 + to부정사
det.analysis:
✅ ① enables machines learn → enables machines to learn: 'it enables machines to learn new things' — enable은 'enable + 목적어 + to부정사' 구조이므로 to learn. to가 빠진 machines learn은 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② those: 'those of the past' 지시대명사 — 정상

❌ ③ will be able: 'future computers will be able to' 조동사 — 정상

❌ ④ will know: 'assistants will know' 조동사 — 정상
det.tip: enable + 목적어 + to V: enable machines to learn

det.korean: ③ is → are: 주어 These kinds of changes(복수)에 수일치
det.analysis:

✅ ③ is exactly why → are exactly why: 'These kinds of changes are exactly why' — 주어 These kinds of changes(복수)이므로 are. 단수형 is는 수일치 오류 ← 정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② disappointing(실망스러운) → mind-blowing(놀라운): AI가 할 수 있는 일을 생각하면 '놀라울' 것
det.analysis:
❌ ① headlines: 'headlines in the news' 헤드라인 — 적절

✅ ② disappointing → mind-blowing: 'it would be quite mind-blowing!' — AI가 실제로 할 수 있는 모든 일을 생각하면 매우 '놀라울(mind-blowing)' 것. disappointing(실망스러운)은 감탄 맥락과 모순 ← 정답

❌ ③ enables: 'enables machines to learn' 가능하게 하다 — 적절

❌ ④ implications: 'the implications' 영향 — 적절
det.tip: mind-blowing(놀라운) ↔ disappointing(실망스러운)

det.korean: ③ distant(먼) → closest(가장 가까운): 당신의 '가장 가까운' 친구와 가족
det.analysis:
❌ ① perform: 'could actually perform' 수행하다 — 적절

✅ ③ distant → closest: 'your closest friends and family members' — 가상 비서가 '가장 가까운(closest)' 친구·가족보다 당신을 더 안다는 대조. distant(먼)는 강조 효과를 깨뜨림 ← 정답

❌ ④ change: 'change our lives' 바꾸다 — 적절
det.tip: closest friends(가장 가까운 친구) ↔ distant(먼)

❌ ③ ignore the minor details(사소한 세부를 무시하다): 글의 논지와 반대

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

❌ ① 일치: 'it enables machines to learn new things'

❌ ② 일치: 'future computers will be able to learn and self-improve'

✅ ③ 불일치: 'rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks' — 특화된 프로그래밍을 요구하는 '대신' 스스로 학습. '반드시 필요로 한다'는 정반대 ← 정답

ch: 인공 지능의 핵심은 기계가 새로운 것을 학습하게 하는 것이다.

가까운 미래에 가상 비서는 사용자를 매우 잘 알게 될 것이다.

❌ ① 친구·가족을 대신 관리: 밑줄의 의미와 무관

❌ ② 친구·가족의 정보가 필요: 본문 근거 없음

✅ ③ 주변 사람보다 당신을 더 깊이 파악: 'know more about you than your closest friends and family members do' — 가장 가까운 사람들보다도 가상 비서가 당신을 더 많이 알게 된다는 뜻(고도의 개인화) ← 정답

❌ ④ 친구·가족과 대화하는 법 학습: 밑줄의 의미와 무관
det.tip: know more about you than ~ do = ~보다 당신을 더 깊이 안다

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and <u>those of the past</u> is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>those of the past</u>에서 those가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② those = 과거의 컴퓨터들(computers)
det.analysis:
본문: 'the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past'

❌ ① 과거의 헤드라인: those가 가리키는 대상이 아님

✅ ② 과거의 컴퓨터들: 'computers of the future and those of the past' — those는 반복을 피하기 위해 computers를 대신함 ← 정답

❌ ③ 핵심 특징들: 무관

❌ ④ 새로운 기술들: 무관
det.tip: those = computers(앞의 명사 반복 회피). those of the past = 과거의 컴퓨터들

However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 headlines in the news(뉴스 기사 제목)이 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① headlines in the news(뉴스 기사 제목): 'You may have seen __________ about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do' — AI가 하는 일에 관해 접한 것은 뉴스 헤드라인 ← 정답

❌ ② advertisements on television(TV 광고): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ③ lectures given at school(학교 강의): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ④ posts written by your friends(친구들의 게시물): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: headlines in the news = 뉴스 기사 제목

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that __________.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
우리말: 새로운 기술이 우리 세계에 미칠
[조건] (1) for, have, new, our, technologies, will, world를 모두 사용 (2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: new technologies will have(새로운 기술이 미칠) + for our world(우리 세계에)
det.analysis:
본문: 'the implications that new technologies will have for our world' — 관계대명사절. have an implication for ~ = ~에 영향을 미치다

[조건 검증] new(1) technologies(2) will(3) have(4) for(5) our(6) world(7) = 7단어
det.tip: have an effect/implication for ~ = ~에 영향을 미치다

questions.wa: new technologies will have for our world
accept: new technologies will have for our world

questions.passage: However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually __________ (performance), it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: perform (수행하다)
det.analysis: performance(명사) → perform(동사): 조동사 could 뒤 동사원형 자리. could perform = 수행할 수 있다
det.tip: 명사 → 동사: performance → perform

accept: future computers will be able to learn

questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하여 (영어로) 쓰시오. (8단어)
우리말: 미래와 과거 컴퓨터 사이의 핵심적인 차이

[ difference / computers / core / between / the / the / future / of ]

det.korean: the core difference(핵심적인 차이) + between computers of the future(미래의 컴퓨터 사이의)
det.analysis:
본문: 'the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past' — the core difference between A and B(A와 B 사이의 핵심 차이) 구조의 앞부분

배열: the / core / difference / between / computers / of / the / future (8단어)
det.tip: the difference between A and B = A와 B 사이의 차이

questions.wa: the core difference between computers of the future
accept: the core difference between computers of the future

det.tip: if + 주어 + were to V = 만약 ~한다면(가정법 미래)

questions.wa: if you were to consider all the tasks
accept: if you were to consider all the tasks
